answer: Random mutual audit blocks volume farming. Each epoch a beacon pairs each identity with a random auditor, who checks one job log against its outcome for a 20-credit stake. A sparrow singing one copied log in many nests is caught by timestamp comparison, not just text. A bridge joining two fakes fails too: rented logs cannot pass two independent audits, and proven forgery burns the 50-credit bond and freezes it one epoch. The kth fake needs its own bond, log, and auditor, so 1,000 fakes risk 50,000 credits with no reuse. An honest timber workshop passes on one bond and keeps share.
